description: Free open-source GitHub template that delivers newly published Japanese subsidy programs, matched against your company profile, to Slack, email, LINE or other channels via GitHub Actions or self-hosting.
rules: Create your company profile with /setup and configure the delivery channel with /setup-channel.
The kit consumes the saita-kun open subsidy data feed (about 12,000 programs, updated daily, CDLA-Permissive-2.0).
Runs on GitHub Actions or your own machine; keep tokens in repository secrets or local environment variables, never in files.
